findings.issue: `basepointChangeSubgroup.normal` preserves normality forward, but the roadmap target is invariance under basepoint change; without a public iff/reflection lemma, proving normality of the original subgroup from the transported subgroup again requires unfolding the transport.

summary: The new API is still one-sided: consumers can prove inclusions into a transported subgroup and infer forward normality, but the basepoint-change/conjugacy interface is missing the reverse/reflection forms needed to use the definition without unfolding.
